DLC2306:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Land, sea, air; morning, noon, night; run, attack, defend; money, power, women; mother, belly, pay packet; voter base, funds, name recognition... So much in life comes in threes...」

DLC2306:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I am about to tell takes place just after the assault on $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$c had welcomed several new allies in quick succession, but that seems to have caused no small amount of commotion.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:4.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$勝平$$... Does your stomach hurt?」

DLC2306:3:t_2:5.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「You ate too much, didn't you? You went back for more at least three times at dinner tonight.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:8.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Get it together. We're on watch tonight, you know.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey... $$宇宙太$$... What's a classic super robot pilot?」

DLC2306:3:t_2:11.en:
$$恵子$$
「Are you worried about what $$ノノ$$ said to you the other day?」

DLC2306:3:t_2:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Of course it pisses me off. I'm working hard fighting in $$ザンボット$$ too, and she made me sound like some kind of fake.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:13.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tell me, $$宇宙太$$! What does 'classic' mean!?」

DLC2306:3:t_2:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「What the hell!? You act like such a know-it-all, but you don't even know what 'classic' means!?」

DLC2306:3:t_2:17.en:
$$恵子$$
「Stop it, both of you! We're about to attack $$ラース・バビロン$$, and you're fighting each other...!」

DLC2306:3:t_2:18.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! I won't ask you guys for anything anymore!」

DLC2306:3:t_2:21.en:
$$恵子$$
「But if he keeps acting like that, won't he cause trouble for everyone in $c...?」

DLC2306:3:t_2:24.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「You know how simpleminded $$勝平$$ is... I bet he'll go to him next.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:25.en:
$$恵子$$
「Oh, right... He'll know how to handle $$勝平$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:26.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「After all, he's a classic himself.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:30.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$: Briefing Room～

DLC2306:3:t_2:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wh-what is it, $$勝平$$...? What's this about...?」

DLC2306:3:t_2:33.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$タケル$$, I'm asking because you're the number-one classic hero in $c! Teach me the essence of being a classic!」

DLC2306:3:t_2:35.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Are you still worried about that thing $$ノノ$$ said to you?」

DLC2306:3:t_2:36.en:
$$勝平$$
「Stay out of this, $$ノリコ$$! This is a conversation between men!」

DLC2306:3:t_2:37.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's no way to talk to me, is it? I'm a super robot pilot too.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:39.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll leave the rest to you, $$ノリコ$$. I'm taking $$ガイヤー$$ out to patrol the area.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:40.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Understood. I know super robots from every era and every corner of the world, so I'll answer all your questions, $$勝平$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:41.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm off, then, $$勝平$$. Leave the watch to me for now.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:43.en:
$$ナオト$$
「Don't just watch him leave. There were clues about being a classic hero in what $$タケル$$ just did.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:45.en:
$$アキラ$$
「You saw it, didn't you? That dazzling smile as he left...」

DLC2306:3:t_2:46.en:
$$ミカ$$
「I think if you're going to be a classic, you've got to have that heroic quality.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:48.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「And in place of answering $$勝平$$'s question, $$タケル$$ volunteered to patrol for all of us.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:49.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「That spirit of service is something a classic hero needs too.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:51.en:
$$ナオト$$
「Maybe if you'd joined the $$ボランティア部$$, you could have learned a little about that too, $$勝平$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:52.en:
$$アキラ$$
「Yeah. Even that brooding $n discovered the joy of picking up litter.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:53.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But I do think $$タケル$$'s heroic quality owes a lot to his natural gifts.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:55.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To put it plainly... his classic good looks!」

DLC2306:3:t_2:61.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't worry. You're still a bit childish, $$勝平$$, but there's a very good chance you'll grow into a handsome man.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:64.en:
$$勝平$$
「I sort of knew already. That I'm different from $$タケル$$...」

DLC2306:3:t_2:65.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「But that's because you're still a boy, $$勝平$$...」

DLC2306:3:t_2:66.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't try to make me feel better. No matter how hard I try, I'll never be a man like $$タケル$$...」

DLC2306:3:t_2:67.en:
$$勝平$$
「And it's not just $$タケル$$... I'll never be as strong as $$竜馬$$, or as cool as $$万丈$$ either...」

DLC2306:3:t_2:68.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll never be a great leader like Dad, or as smart as $$イチ$$, or have Grandpa's presence...」

DLC2306:3:t_2:70.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm sure I'll always be a little kid, no matter how much time passes...」

DLC2306:3:t_2:72.en:
$$勝平$$
「But in $c, I'm lumped in with the elementary school kids, like $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:73.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm... just treated as an elementary school kid...」

DLC2306:3:t_2:74.en:
$$ロゼ$$
（$$勝平$$... I had no idea you were thinking about all that...）

DLC2306:3:t_2:75.en:
$$ノリコ$$
（I thought he was just a mischievous kid, but he's sensitive too...）

DLC2306:3:t_2:76.en:
$$ナオト$$
「That's... the $$クラッシャー隊$$'s emergency call signal!」

DLC2306:3:t_2:77.en:
$$ミカ$$
「It's from $$タケル$$, who's out on reconnaissance!」

DLC2306:3:t_2:78.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「$$タケル$$ reports that he's spotted an approaching Imperial force.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:79.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「$c is badly worn down from the fighting during the day. Those of us on watch will intercept them.」

DLC2306:3:t_2:82.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's go, $$勝平$$. I know you've got a lot on your mind, but right now, fight to protect everyone.」

review.context: Kappei broods over Nono calling him an unorthodox super robot pilot. Takeru and the Crusher Team's explanations of classic heroism accidentally deepen his insecurity, until an enemy alert requires the watch team to sortie.
decisions: Classic hero is the recurring sense of orthodoxy in this comic discussion; it is not a proper classification or glossary term.
AG's triple examples preserve all six sets, with the last set explained through familiar English political terms.
Kappei's entrance uses a dojo-style challenge suited to his exaggerated delivery.
Ryouma and Banjo are admired older comrades, not literal brothers; Ichi is a family nickname.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
Measured-fit revision preserves all source details with more concise wording; all six triads remain in the AG list where applicable.
